description: Use it only after the person chose one or more yachts from a search_yachts, best_deals or get_yacht answer, gave their days and party, and said yes to a written quote: ask them before you call it. Pass the page links exactly as those answers returned them, the days, the party and anything they want the desk to know, in their words. The desk sends a formal quote in writing, with every cost on it, to the person's own email or phone; this answer only says it was received and where the quote goes. Nothing is booked or paid: the person confirms the booking with the desk.

email.description: The person's own email, as they gave it: the quote is sent there. This, phone or session is needed.

items.description: The yacht page links to quote (absolute URLs on this site), exactly as a search, best_deals or get returned them. At most 20.

name.description: Optional: the person's name, as they gave it.

notes.description: What the person wants the desk to know, in their words (at most 2000 characters).

phone.description: The person's own phone, international form (+ and country code), as they gave it. This, email or session is needed.

session.description: The session an earlier request_quote answer returned. Pass it instead of email or phone.

name: request_quote

nextStep.description: Where the written quote goes, in words to tell the person.

session.description: Only on the call that created the contact: pass it from then on.

sessionExpiresAt.description: When that session stops working, ISO time.

status.description: received: the desk has the request; already_received: this session asked the same in the last day.

title: Request a formal quote
